description: This file defines a functional interface StreamDataWriter used to write data to an OutputStream, likely as part of a streaming data service within the OpenMRS project. It facilitates conversion from OutputStream to InputStream without loading all data into memory, with the write operation potentially executing in a separate thread.

classes.name: StreamDataWriter
classes.description: A functional interface for writing data to an OutputStream, with thread-safety considerations.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Defines the method to perform writing data to the provided OutputStream, possibly in a separate thread, and may throw IOException.
